raw_Final.answer: The net change in the balance of unrecognized tax benefits from the end of fiscal 2007 to the end of fiscal 2008 is an increase of $87.8 million.
raw_Final.explanation: Ending balance at December 27, 2008 was $214.4 million; ending balance at December 29, 2007 was $126.6 million. Net change = 214.4 - 126.6 = 87.8 million. This is corroborated by the reconciliation components for fiscal 2008: 126.6 + 14.2 - 4.6 + 83.8 - 5.6 = 214.4.
